name: collab-code-platform
description: Phase 4 collaborative browser IDE with accounts, workspace access control, PostgreSQL persistence, and sandboxed website previews.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @collab/shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @collab/api" "npm run dev --workspace @collab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @collab/shared && npm run build --workspace @collab/api && npm run build --workspace @collab/web
